memory_update.text: AMSC is the strongest US-listed underfollowed direct node candidate for this pass because D-VAR STATCOM / VVO maps directly to reactive power, voltage stability, renewable interconnection, and power-quality needs.

PLPC should be tracked as a second-order transmission hardware beneficiary with possible utility-specification stickiness, but not treated as direct HVDC/FACTS exposure until voltage-class and project-level evidence is verified.

NVEC is a speculative-shadow component candidate; keep only if later evidence shows sensors/couplers/isolators designed into power-conversion, STATCOM, HVDC, grid-monitoring, or utility automation equipment.

US-listed pure-play suppliers of high-voltage reactors, harmonic filters, instrument transformers, and HVDC/FACTS subcomponents appear sparse; many cleaner names may be non-US listings in India, Canada, Europe, Japan, Korea, or Taiwan.
Use GE Vernova only as a reference anchor for the component map and customer/supplier discovery, not as the main underfollowed candidate.

node: HVDC, FACTS, high-voltage reactors, harmonic filters, STATCOM systems, instrument transformers, and grid power-quality equipment
summary: US-listed pure-play exposure to HVDC/FACTS and high-voltage power-quality components is limited. The cleanest direct US-listed underfollowed candidate found in this pass is American Superconductor, because it sells D-VAR STATCOM / Volt-VAR products tied to reactive power, voltage stability, renewable interconnection, and grid power quality. Preformed Line Products is a second-order transmission-hardware beneficiary rather than a FACTS/HVDC component supplier, but it fits the obscure utility-approved hardware lane. Powell Industries is included as a higher-market-cap, less pure but relevant packaged electrical distribution / switchgear / monitoring beneficiary for utility and data-center power buildouts. NVE is a speculative-shadow candidate: its rugged magnetic sensors and couplers plausibly map to sensing/isolation/control functions inside industrial power electronics, but direct HVDC/FACTS revenue evidence was not found in this pass.
